verdict.score_rationale: This lands on the 7 anchor because it is a composed, registry-aware operational map with clean routing and mostly steady registers, but the oversized vertical dead band and sparse final section keep it from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The upper and middle clusters use the width intentionally, but a conspicuous empty band separates them from section 8, and substantial unused space remains below that section.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Registry colors are applied consistently: human is yellow, router teal, cache blue, send/eval green, guardrails red, and infrastructure plus shape-core steps gray.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions or obvious waypoint terminations are visible, though the long overlapping gray and dashed return routes across the center create mild routing ambiguity.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Panel headers, major rows, and icon-caption pairs generally align, but density drops abruptly in the widely spaced audit row and the large gap above it weakens the overall rhythm.
